game: God of War: Chains of Olympus
target: 100% completion on the chosen PS3 Origins remaster route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The PS3 Origins menu, difficulty selector, manual save slots, and bonus menu.
areas.note: Chosen route: PS3 Origins Collection remaster through original hardware or RPCS3.

save_backup.title: Create the rotating save set
save_backup.why: No chapter select is available after crossing one-way campaign transitions.

levels.1: Confirm the remastered handheld entry before starting.
levels.2: Play Chains of Olympus through God of War: Origins Collection or God of War Saga on PS3 or RPCS3.
levels.3: Launch the PS3 Origins remaster, select Chains of Olympus, and create its save data. This version supplies the highest-fidelity official route; no PSP-exclusive gameplay branch is required.

levels.1: The campaign has no chapter-select cleanup.
levels.2: Retain a save at the start of every major physical region.
levels.3: Rotate at least three manual slots and keep a permanent save before the deep-prison and final-temple transitions. Extra grey chests can replace missed meter pieces, but a backup avoids a full replay after the final opportunities.

levels.1: The initial clear opens the bonus completion menus.
levels.2: Finish the campaign on any available difficulty and save the clear data.
levels.3: Complete the final result, accept the clear-data prompt, and return to the menu. Confirm Challenge of Hades, God difficulty, the first costume, both first-clear videos, and the character gallery are available.

levels.1: The final costume and bonus gallery require the hardest preset.
levels.2: Finish a full campaign on the unlocked God difficulty.
levels.3: After the first clear, start God difficulty, keep the preset unchanged, and finish the complete campaign. Save the result and confirm the third costume, making-of video, and outtakes gallery unlock.

levels.1: Five pieces create each meter increase.
levels.2: Follow the earliest stable route for all 30 meter collectibles.
levels.3: Use the numbered items in this pack and verify the status counter after every chest. Each group of five expands its meter; later plain chests can substitute earlier misses until all fifteen of that category are collected.

areas.name: Coastal Battlefield
areas.location_cue: A burning coastal city with a battering ram, ladders, ballistae, ramps, and a dark final corridor.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: this linear region has no chapter-select cleanup.

save_backup.title: Save before leaving Coastal Battlefield
save_backup.why: Preserve a file before the last one-way obstacle in case a plain chest was missed.

levels.1: Sweep side ledges and plain chests before the region's final traversal.
levels.2: Finish the full route through Coastal Battlefield.
levels.3: Enter the region with a fresh rotating save, solve every mandatory traversal mechanism, and open all visible red, recovery, and plain chests along each branch. Confirm every collectible listed below before crossing the final one-way exit.

levels.1: Break scenery and finish optional enemy waves while exploring.
levels.2: Open every red chest and clear every finite encounter in Coastal Battlefield.
levels.3: Check all side rooms used by the collectible route, break destructible objects, and finish each locked combat wave. Spend red orbs only after the region is fully swept so the upgrade ledger remains easy to audit.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: At the battering-ram gate, search the ground immediately to its left.
levels.3: Push the ram to the sealed gate but pause before breaking through. Walk along the gate's left side and open the plain chest tucked beside the wall. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: Halfway up the battlefield ladder, drop onto the side ledge with the plain chest.
levels.3: Begin climbing the tall battlefield ladder, watch for the chest level with the middle of the climb, and release onto its ledge. Open it, then return to the ladder. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: After firing the ballista at the large target, climb the next room's ladder.
levels.3: Leave the ballista platform, enter the following room, and climb its ladder. Open the plain chest waiting at the top before taking the next route. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: Beyond the cyclops encounter, check the left side of the archer room.
levels.3: Finish the large-enemy arena, proceed into the room occupied by archers, and search along its left wall. Open the plain chest before leaving. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: Use the rotating ballista on the buildings, then enter the broken structure beyond the archers.
levels.3: Aim the rotating ballista at the accessible buildings before advancing. Past the archer room, climb the wall, cross the ramp into the damaged building, and open its plain chest. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: Inside the ballista-opened building, jump the gap on the right.
levels.3: After entering the damaged building from the ramp, inspect its right side, double-jump across the interior gap, and open the plain chest on the separated ledge. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: At the dark-corridor save point, continue straight toward the colour-blended chest.
levels.3: Reach the save light in the dark corridor, face directly forward instead of following the exit, and approach the chest camouflaged by the background colours. Open it before the final coastal encounter. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.3: Ride the elevator upward, step off, turn right, and follow the ledge down a few stairs. Open the plain chest before taking the central route. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.

levels.3: Finish the first encounter with the flame-armoured enemy, pass the next save light, and walk down the stairs immediately beyond it. Open the plain chest at the bottom. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.
levels.2: After the lower elevator, activate the shining floor point, cross the fallen pillar, and go far right.
levels.3: Ride down, use the glowing interaction on the floor, and cross the pillar that changes position. Follow the landing all the way right and open the plain chest at its end. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.

levels.3: Complete the wall transition into the far half of the wind chamber, then move diagonally up-right instead of leaving. Open the plain chest in the corner. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

levels.1: Plain chests often sit just outside the camera's main route.

levels.3: Enter the chamber with the active portal leading toward the caves, stop before stepping through, and open the visible plain chest in front of the portal. Confirm the collectible counter advances before leaving the region.

areas.name: Arsenal and Relics
areas.location_cue: The pause-menu power-up screen and inventory page showing weapons, magic, shield, key, and lance.
areas.note: All six upgradable tools require 75,000 red orbs in total.

levels.1: Invest in one unfinished tool at a time.
levels.2: Raise Chained Blades to level 5.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and buy every tier in order: 2,650 + 4,850 + 8,750 + 11,250 red orbs, 27,500 total. Confirm the menu displays level 5 with no remaining purchase.

levels.1: Invest in one unfinished tool at a time.
levels.2: Raise Fire Area Power to level 3.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and buy every tier in order: 3,500 + 10,000 red orbs, 13,500 total. Confirm the menu displays level 3 with no remaining purchase.

levels.1: Invest in one unfinished tool at a time.
levels.2: Raise Reflective Shield to level 2.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and buy every tier in order: 1,500 red orbs, 1,500 total. Confirm the menu displays level 2 with no remaining purchase.

levels.1: Invest in one unfinished tool at a time.
levels.2: Raise Ranged Light Power to level 3.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and buy every tier in order: 2,250 + 6,250 red orbs, 8,500 total. Confirm the menu displays level 3 with no remaining purchase.

levels.1: Invest in one unfinished tool at a time.
levels.2: Raise Heavy Gauntlet to level 3.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and buy every tier in order: 3,750 + 10,250 red orbs, 14,000 total. Confirm the menu displays level 3 with no remaining purchase.

levels.1: Invest in one unfinished tool at a time.
levels.2: Raise Spreading Flame Power to level 3.
levels.3: Open the power-up menu and buy every tier in order: 3,000 + 7,000 red orbs, 10,000 total. Confirm the menu displays level 3 with no remaining purchase.

levels.1: A complete exploration route supplies enough red orbs without an exploit.
levels.2: Spend 75,000 red orbs across all six upgradable tools.
levels.3: Complete the six maximum-upgrade entries in this area. Sweep every red chest, destructible object, and finite enemy wave before the last save; confirm the combined menu has no unfinished tier.

levels.1: A side route in the underworld holds the key to a large optional temple.
levels.2: Take the key before entering the deep-prison temple route.
levels.3: Search the underworld side chambers before the deep descent, collect the Cryptkeeper Key, and verify it appears in inventory. Use it at the large optional temple door before leaving the deep prison.

levels.1: The flooded caves contain the mandatory diving relic.
levels.2: Take the lance before entering the underwater maze.
levels.3: Reach the relic pedestal in the flooded caves, collect it, and test a sustained dive plus charged underwater dash. Confirm the breathing limit is removed before continuing.

levels.1: The reflective shield gains a projectile-return property.
levels.2: Complete the shield tutorial that reflects a projectile into its source.
levels.3: Acquire the shield in the sun temple, then complete the mandatory timed parry tutorial. Block at the impact flash and verify the incoming projectile is returned rather than merely stopped.

areas.name: Challenge of Hades
areas.location_cue: The post-clear bonus menu and five isolated trial arenas.
areas.note: Complete all five trials to unlock the second costume and challenge-gated bonus material.

levels.1: The five trials appear after the first clear.
levels.2: Finish the campaign once and enter Challenge of Hades from the bonus menu.
levels.3: Save the first clear, return to the bonus menu, and start the five-trial set. Maximum upgrades are recommended because completion unlocks a costume, removed-level video, and environment gallery.

levels.1: Read the failure condition before attacking.
levels.2: Burn 50 soldiers using only the fire-area power.
levels.3: Group the soldiers before casting, and immediately switch to the heavy gauntlet when a large enemy enters. Prevent that enemy from killing a soldier; any soldier defeated by another method fails the trial.

levels.1: Read the failure condition before attacking.
levels.2: Defeat 20 fire guards without taking a hit.
levels.3: Use charged gauntlet punches to force each target to flinch, roll as soon as a spinning leap begins, and keep the group in front of the camera. Restart after any damage.

levels.1: Read the failure condition before attacking.
levels.2: Defeat every wave before the draining health meter empties.
levels.3: Use charged gauntlet attacks on the opening large target, grab the forty flying enemies for immediate kills, and save the civilian health drops until needed. Finish the final three armoured enemies with charged punches.

levels.1: Read the failure condition before attacking.
levels.2: Destroy all 40 objects within 60 seconds.
levels.3: Open with the fire-area spell to clear the ring around the starting point, then use charged gauntlet punches on stone figures and small objects. Sweep the perimeter once before time expires.

levels.1: Read the failure condition before attacking.
levels.2: Defeat every enemy in the unrestricted final trial.
levels.3: Use the supplied health and magic chests only after their meters are meaningfully depleted. Prioritize dangerous ranged targets, use area powers on clusters, and finish every wave.
